results.title: Victa Super Mulcher Thomas The Tank Lawn Mower Problems Repair & Review
results.content: it will take a few more years before I can really decide if I like this Victa lawn mower. Lets hope Victa can take on board my concerns related to the zone start feature, it needs to be refined or removed from the lawn mower design. I really wonder who else has had the same problem I encountered. [...] The Victa lawn mower was invented in 1952, in the backyard of Mervyn Victor Richardson in Concord, Australia. In 1951, Mervyn's son Garry mowed lawns to earn money in university holidays. Garry borrowed Mervyn's cylinder-based power mower which was heavy to transport and to operate. Mervyn wanted to design a new mower for his son's business. Mervyn had seen Lawrence Hall's 'Mowhall' rotary lawn mower demonstrated in 1948. The heavy Mowhall was not a very successful invention because it required two people to use it, one to push and one to pull. Although Richardson had developed rotating reel mowers for his son's business, in August 1952 he decided to make a rotary lawn mower similar to the Mowhall, using a Villiers two-stroke engine mounted on its side but utilising a lighter base plate, [...] Lawnmower Vs Thomas The Tank! Victa lawn mowers are world famous, here is my review and repair of a Victa (Icta because my V fell off) Super Mulcher 18 inch Mulch Or Catch Lawn Mower. I tried to support a product designed and assembled in Australia with an American made Briggs and Stratton motor sourced with global parts because I was trying to steer clear of Made In China. For me it was a very rough start having the problems with a starting system that's making the mower safer, yet I feel the reverse has happened. My previous lawn mower was a GMC mower purchased from Bunnings Hardware Australia. It lasted 8 years and considering how cheap it was I felt it served very well. Sure there were problems but they were easily fixed. Anyway it will take a few more years before I can really decide
